summary: State-dependent vtable dispatch for a UI control. Reads a mode (0-4) from ShortComputation_6720(this) and, per mode, maps boolean input a2 to a specific argument for a virtual method at offset 64. Cases 0 and 2 invoke the method only when a2 is set; cases 1 and 3 only when a2 is clear; case 4 gates the dispatch on the current state byte from ByteFieldGetterAt100 and selects the argument 0/1 or 2/3 based on RangeCheck. Default case returns the mode unchanged. Called by UIControlStateChangeHandler (00487960) and InitDispatchWithVTableCheck (004879E0).

local_names.a2: boolean state input controlling which vtable argument is used
local_names.v2: switch selector from ShortComputation_6720, also carries the function result
local_names.v3: this pointer alias (ecx) used as the vtable call receiver in cases 0-4
local_names.v8: boolean a2 != 0, used as the base argument in case 4

operations.description: Compute the control mode by calling ShortComputation_6720(this); the result selects the switch case.
Switch on the mode 0-4 using the jump table jpt_48776F; a mode outside 0-4 falls through to the default return.
Case 0: if a2 is non-zero, invoke the virtual method at offset 64 on this with argument 1.
Case 1: if a2 is zero, invoke the virtual method at offset 64 on this with argument 0.
Case 2: if a2 is non-zero, invoke the virtual method at offset 64 on this with argument 3.
Case 3: if a2 is zero, invoke the virtual method at offset 64 on this with argument 2.
Case 4: read the current state byte via ByteFieldGetterAt100; only when it is zero, base the argument on a2 != 0 and add 2 when RangeCheck is true, then invoke the virtual method at offset 64.
Return the accumulated result v2 (mode or last vtable call result); the default case returns the mode unchanged.
